approved_scope.title: Chough 0.6.0 human-first records: one Markdown file with YAML front matter per record, date+slug session folders with an append-only timeline that fold into one archived story at finish, a knowledge vault that links and never copies, no local facts or credentials in committed records, a human's gate approval drives the SpecSync approval as that human, and chough migrate converts 0.5.x projects with a digest receipt
approved_scope.description: Chough 0.6.0 human-first records: one Markdown file with YAML front matter per record, date+slug session folders with an append-only timeline that fold into one archived story at finish, a knowledge vault that links and never copies, no local facts or credentials in committed records, a human's gate approval drives the SpecSync approval as that human, and chough migrate converts 0.5.x projects with a digest receipt
acceptance_criteria: Approval as the human (FLOW-23, FLOW-24, issue 236): closing a scope or acceptance gate with a human's decision records the matching SpecSync approval or review as that human, whose identity comes from configuration or the approving channel, with their exact words, where and when, and the relaying agent; with no identity configured for that human it refuses rather than guess; an approval on authority the human gave in advance names the agent and quotes the human's earlier words and where

Bugs: every open Chough bug is fixed with a regression case, including Chough's own records staying out of SpecSync's verification (issue 12), or closed with a link when it was already fixed elsewhere (BUG-0002 and BUG-0003 as fixed upstream), and the criteria #212 marks superseded are retired with hi retire, with KNOW-24 reworded, in the commits that remove what implemented them

Data loss regression (issue 165): with earlier archived sessions present and knowledge/ not committed, advancing accept to done leaves every earlier archived session file byte-identical in place and adds only the new story. The 0.5.x reproduction is recorded failing first and linked to a local bug

Dogfood: this whole change runs on the 0.5.0 build; after it is archived, with no change open and Leif's consent, this repository is migrated with the 0.6.0 build, and the next change on this branch, the 0.6.0 release preparation, runs intent to done in the new format; fmt, lint, the full tests, the cases this change adds and fledge lanes run verify pass on macOS and Linux; no other repository changes; no 0.6.0 tag or release until that dogfood is complete and no Chough bug is open, and the release still waits for Leif's go

Gates (issue 237): an open human gate holds only the stage it names, so a gate for a later decision such as a release no longer refuses unrelated stage moves, and chough next still lists every open gate
Guides (DRIVE-28): .chough/README.md and knowledge/index.md orient a new reader, and case definitions stay TOML with their format unchanged

Migration (DRIVE-27, LIFE-20): chough migrate previews by default, writes nothing and prints the plan's digest, and --apply runs only that previewed plan, only with the human's consent and never while a native change is open (KNOW-10 and KNOW-11, carried forward); --apply writes the 0.6.0 tree create-new only, never replacing a file, removes the 0.5.x files only after every new file is written and read back, writes a receipt with the digest of every file before and after, redacts home-folder paths from every file it rewrites, never weakens a SpecSync archive, and is tested on copies from every release 0.1.0 to 0.5.0. A second apply reports nothing to do, the 0.6.0 reader refuses an unmigrated tree with refused:unmigrated naming chough migrate, and chough doctor lists what is left

Names (DRIVE-27): new records are named YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>, never by a sequence number; a same-day clash gets a short suffix at creation; every 0.5.x ID keeps resolving as an alias in links, bug commands, observation, case and checkpoint references

No leaks (LIFE-26, FLOW-22, issues 234 and 208): a write whose text holds a home path, the local user or host name, a token, key or credential is refused, or redacted with --redact, naming the field and the kind but never the value. External evidence is recorded by a neutral id and its fingerprint, with its path only in the git-ignored .chough/local/. chough doctor and the verify lane scan committed records and fail on any finding

Records (DRIVE-25, DRIVE-26): every session, evidence entry and bug Chough writes is one Markdown file with YAML front matter, decisions are entries in their session's file, and no JSON twin exists. After chough migrate --apply on a 0.5.x fixture and on this repository, .chough/ holds no session.json, transitions.jsonl, history/, sessions/*.json, evidence/*.json or bugs/*.json, and every command works from the Markdown files alone

Sessions (DRIVE-24, DRIVE-25): each session is .chough/sessions/<date-slug>/session.md, whose front matter carries the checkpoint and whose append-only Timeline section carries every stage move, gate and correction, with an agent/ folder for working files. Two branches that advance different sessions merge with no conflict, and a session only ever closes itself, never on another session's switch (#207). At finish the session becomes one .chough/archive/sessions/<date-slug>.md story with its evidence receipts folded into What was verified, and its folder, agent/ included, leaves the tree

Vault (KNOW-30 to KNOW-33): knowledge/ holds only index.md, journal/ posts with a generated feed.xml, lessons/ for lessons that span projects, and pre-existing library/ and briefs/ content as is. knowledge/intent/, knowledge/archives/, attachments and generated session, bug and module notes are gone, no Chough step copies or moves a tracked record into the vault, the move into done writes a short journal post that links the archived story, and library index --check passes

Who and corrections (LIFE-17, LIFE-18, PRs 233 and 210): each timeline entry, evidence entry and bug records the acting agent, model and hc terminal when known and never fails when they are unknown; chough correct appends a correction linked to the original entry, also on an archived story, and next and status show the corrected text

answers.constraints: AGENTS.md: HI owns human wording and criterion IDs, SpecSync owns contracts, approval, review and archive, Chough owns only its own records; preserve existing files and others' edits; never invent results; no model client, runtime, hosted service or duplicate lifecycle state; Fledge first; minimal dependencies, so front matter uses a strict YAML subset with no new crate. Lessons (cli.3md, history and reporting context): a delta is frozen at approval and change check refuses an edited one; change check refuses unchecked tasks.md boxes, so human gates and case runs are plain text; test in a project adopted from legacy, not only a fresh one (2026-11-05); the move into done is already slow with many archives, so add no native read to it (2026-11-04); two open native changes on one branch stale each other's verification (2026-11-05); tests/spec_split.rs pins moved requirement bodies, so changing a pinned body names this change in the pin. Leif's decisions (2026-11-10): one change released as 0.6.0 and dogfooded on the chough repo only, other repos after release at 95 percent confidence; Windows is best-effort through WSL; the issue 165 copy-never-move decision is superseded by KNOW-30 links-never-copies. Also: #212's rule book (88e53eba) wins on wording, so KNOW-10 and KNOW-11 are carried forward as the upgrade's rules (never weaken a SpecSync archive; preview first, apply only with consent and never while a native change is open) and the 18 criteria it marks superseded are retired; the independent alignment audit (629 items) is folded in; Leif's later decisions: fix every open Chough bug, the agent's name on approvals given in advance (FLOW-24) with the standing <agent>-<terminal> actor rule, no Git history rewrite, and dogfood with zero open Chough bugs before any tag or release; Chough's record folders stay out of SpecSync verification through its documented verification_ignored_paths, so this change's paths name .chough/cases/ and .chough/README.md rather than all of .chough/

approvals.note: Leif re-approved the six build-time delta corrections (plan.md, Delta corrections 1 to 6) himself on 2026-11-12, after the coordinator agent's (claude-code-t370) one-line summary of each. Relayed by t370.
